description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RoboticBurger" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order" />
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Status" name="Status update" />
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Delivery" name="Order delivered" />

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoboticBurger">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller" processRef="Process_Robot" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Status" name="Status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Status" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Order delivered" sourceRef="EndEvent_Delivered" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Delivery" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller Process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_AskMenu" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AskMenu" name="Ask whether customer wants menu or just burger" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskMenuDone" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Gateway_Type" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Type" name="Menu or just burger?" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_Type" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Customer wants a menu</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Just burger" sourceRef="Gateway_Type" targetRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Customer wants just the burger</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Menu_Split" name="Menu split" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAskSide" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Split" targetRef="Task_AskSide" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration depends on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AskSide" name="Ask whether customer wants fries or wedges" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSideDone" sourceRef="Task_AskSide" targetRef="Gateway_Side_Split" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Side_Split" name="Fries or wedges?" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_Side_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Customer wants fries</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_Side_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Customer wants wedges</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration depends on the portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration depends on the portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_Side_Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_Side_Merge" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Side_Merge" name="Side prepared" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Side_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Join" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Menu_Join" name="Menu join" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuDone" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Burger_Merge" name="Ready to prepare burger" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToBurger" sourceRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration depends on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Status">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusTimer" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_SendStatus" />

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatus" name="Send enthusiastic status update" messageRef="Msg_Status" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSent" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusSent" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusSent" name="Status update sent" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_Deliver" />

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Deliver" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered" sourceRef="Task_Deliver" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Delivery" messageRef="Msg_Delivery" />
    </bpmn:endEvent>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
